items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had heard my group. He made an offer that to me, it didn’t make any sense. But that group became world travelers for a number of years.

ctx.x: ECM Records. Manfred Eichner or something.

Yeah. Manfred Eicher. That’s right. I felt robbed, because he took all the people. He had heard my group. He made an offer that to me, it didn’t make any sense. But that group became world travelers for a number of years.

And still are. Here’s one thing that Jan Garbarek had to say about you. He said, “George enlightened me about a different way of playing music, an analytical way which enabled me to go on learning about music on my own.”
